paragraphs: Delivering quality dental care to Mocksville in a compassionate, considerate, and respectful manner.

Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Riccobene Family Dentistry in Mocksville is located off US-601 and I-40, making it easily accessible to families across Davie County. The office sits near Cooper Creek Heights and just a short drive from Rich Park and downtown Mocksville.

We are proud to serve this welcoming community with state-of-the-art dental technology and compassionate care. Patients from Bermuda Run, Cooleemee, and beyond find our Mocksville office a convenient home for their dental health needs.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.

Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

A wide variety of services are available in our Mocksville, NC location including general & pediatric dentistry, routine hygiene, emergency dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (including whitening) and dental implants.
Give us a call at (336) 753-6630 or book an appointment online today.
Yes - you can get both dental implants or a consultation for implants at our Mocksville location.

We’re open Monday-Wednesday, 8:30am - 5pm and on Thursdays 9:00am - 3pm.

DR. TITUS BRINAGER was raised in Statesville, NC and discovered his passion for dentistry early on, inspired by his mother’s career as a dental hygienist. He graduated Magna Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Science in Biology from Lenoir-Rhyne University, then earned his Doctorate of Dental Surgery from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill School of Dentistry. With over a decade of experience, Dr. Brinager has received advanced training in cosmetic dentistry, endodontics, oral surgery, and implants, allowing him to provide comprehensive care tailored to each patient’s needs.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are available for families and children in Mocksville?

A wide variety of services are available in our Mocksville, NC location including general & pediatric dentistry, routine hygiene, emergency dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (including whitening) and dental implants.

How can I schedule a dental appointment at the Mocksville office?

Give us a call at (336) 753-6630 or book an appointment online today.

Can I get dental implants or a consultation in Mocksville?

Yes - you can get both dental implants or a consultation for implants at our Mocksville location.

Does the Mocksville office offer cosmetic services such as whitening or veneers?

Yes - cosmetic services like whitening, veneers and Invisalign® are available at our Mocksville location.

Are emergency dental appointments available in Mocksville?

We make an effort to see all emergency patients same day or next day, but there may be instances where we’ll refer you to another of our convenient practices if schedules are tight so make sure you’re seen as soon as possible.

What are the Mocksville office hours and location details?

We’re open Monday-Wednesday, 8:30am - 5pm and on Thursdays 9:00am - 3pm.

Do you accept my dental insurance or offer membership/financing plans in Mocksville?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
